body:
Random Thoughts

If you don't mind, please mind your mind.

The mind is one of the strange aspects within us. If taken care properly, it acts as a responsible leader in spreading joy not only inside but also to the entire world. On the other hand, if not handled properly, it acts as a cruel enemy to oneself, whom would never have encountered.

The mind always seeks for proud, self proud. It requires continuous motivation to be supplied either within or outside. Inspiration from within we term as willpower and encouragement from outside comes in the form of appreciation.

The funny behaviour of the mind, it always wants more, always seek more. Never it will be contented.

Travelling is seen as the most adventurous in this world for the mind. If you fear of new experiences, either you have to blindfold it or make it tired. Blindfolding is practically an impossible task (art) because it needs to be done, by the mind only. The only option left out is making it tired or occupy it by performing routines. Routines can be in the name of self or for others, but with dedication. Binding with an object or falling in love with someone, provides immense commitment required for the mind, for the powerful mind, your mind, not to trouble you...

If you don't mind, please mind your mind!!!

-K Vijay Anand

30-09-2020
